scope.invariant: Every recognized sourceMappingURL= directive must contain the complete allowed local value main.js.map, so a remote/path/data reference cannot mask itself with the same suffix in query, fragment or repeated marker.

findings.change: Rust uses split_once on each line and Node uses the first marker offset plus the entire remainder; both compare the whole trimmed reference with main.js.map instead of matching the line suffix. Any additional query/fragment/path/data/marker remains part of the rejected value.

positiveBehavior: Exact local reference without final newline
Multiple valid local directives on separate lines
refusals: Parent traversal with a masked tail
Second directive glued to a local value
Query appended to the local name
Remote directive followed by a valid local line
